subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The driver was taken to the nearest dispensary by the beggars.

options.text: The beggars take the driver to the nearest dispensary.
The beggars took the driver to dispensary.
The beggars took the driver to the nearest dispensary.
To the nearest dispensary, the beggars took the driver.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'The beggars took the driver to the nearest dispensary'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it to Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case) + was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The driver'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'The beggars. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'was taken' will be changed into 'took'. 
 
• Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be removed.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *The beggars took the driver to the nearest dispensary.*
